_comment: Binding court directives that no test names, from scripts/check_order_directives.py.
This file waives COURT ORDERS, so it is held to a higher bar than the other exemption
files, not a lower one: every entry names an owner, an expiry, and a reason that says
WHICH KIND of unbound this is and what binding it would take. 'It is fine' is not a
Baselined 2026-07-26, when the gate first ran: 102 binding directives, 57 already bound
by a test naming both the order and the directive, 45 recorded here. The number may only
go down - that is the whole point of writing it down.
Three of the classes below are bindable work that has not been done. One is not: a
Principal gate on a live cutover cannot be decided by CI, and a test claiming otherwise
would be precisely the false claim this gate exists to catch.

AUDIT-DEPTH-001:D8.reason: Not code-testable and correctly so: it is a PRINCIPAL GATE on a live cutover or an external credential. Nothing in this repository can decide whether the Principal has given the go, and a test that claimed to would be the false claim this gate exists to stop. Enforced by the deploy record, not by CI.

CHAT-ATTACHMENTS-001:D1.reason: A behaviour directive whose enforcement almost certainly EXISTS - the order has a dedicated test file that names it - but which no test names by directive id, so a rename or deletion of the enforcing test would not break anything. Binding is a labelling pass over that file, of the kind done for COUNTY 7 and COUNTY 10 in this same commit; it needs the directive read against each test to be honest rather than decorative.

CHAT-ATTACHMENTS-001:D5.reason: A 'pin invariants ...' directive. It orders the order's OWN behaviours declared in tests/invariants.yaml with binding debt zero, which the invariants gate half-enforces already (every DECLARED invariant is bound). What is missing is the other half - that these particular ones are declared at all - and that is a real test, of the shape now written for COUNTY 7 D9 and COUNTY 10 D7. Deferred only because each needs its own invariant list read off the order.

CHAT-ATTACHMENTS-001:D6.reason: A directive about the RECORD rather than a behaviour: it orders a docstring, an honesty doc or an amended invariant description to say a particular thing. Bindable by asserting the text, which is exactly the shape of this programme, and not yet done.
